extDescription.message: Toggle dark to light with memory.

actionTitleDefault.message: Toggle Color Theme - Click to toggle & remember

optIntro.message: All option settings are stored as pseudo-bookmarks inside the bookmark folder you select. They are not bookmarks for opening web pages; they only store settings. When Chrome starts, the settings are loaded from that folder.

optFolderHint.message: Select the bookmark folder used to store settings. When you change the folder and close the options page, the pseudo-bookmarks are deleted from the previous folder and saved to the new one.

optFolderMissing.message: The saved folder was not found. Please select another folder.

optFolderLoadFailed.message: Could not read the list of bookmark folders.

optSitesHint.message: Websites turned ON with the toolbar icon. Enter a URL and press Add to register a new site, or press Delete to remove one. Matching is done per URL origin (protocol + host + port).

optLoaded.message: Settings loaded from the save folder.

optSaved.message: Saved as pseudo-bookmarks in the save folder.

optSavedNoFolder.message: No folder selected, so it is saved in extension storage. Select a folder to save the settings as pseudo-bookmarks.

optDirty.message: Unsaved changes (saved automatically, and when this page is closed).
